title: Apps Dev Tech Lead Analyst - C13 - CHENNAI
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking a senior, hands-on **Fenergo Technical Configurator** at the Vice President level to lead the end-to-end functional platform configuration across our global KYCX (Know Your Customer / Client Experience) estate.

This is a senior **Individual Contributor** role. You will be responsible for the technical configuration design and hands-on implementation of client journeys, policy rule sets, dynamic document models, risk rating logic, and security entitlements within Fenergo CLM. The position requires a deep technical understanding of Fenergo's declarative framework, data model, and workflow engine to translate complex institutional compliance requirements into scalable, maintainable platform configurations without writing custom application code.

**Core Accountabilities**
=========================

**1. Journey & Workflow Engine Configuration**
----------------------------------------------

* Own the technical design, configuration, and end-to-end testing of complex client lifecycle journeys across Corporate, Institutional, and Commercial Banking lines of business.

* Build and maintain workflows for Net-New Onboarding, Periodic KYC Refreshes, Event-Driven/Triggered Reviews, Material Change Ingestion, and Offboarding.

* Configure dynamic stage-gates, milestone triggers, complex decision splits, task orchestration, operational handoffs, and parallel processing branches.

* Implement SLA trackers, escalation paths, and automated fallback/exception handling mechanisms across jurisdictional booking locations.

**2. Policy, Risk & Regulatory Rules Setup**
--------------------------------------------

* Configure and maintain the Fenergo Policy Manager, Regulatory Rule Engine, and Entity Requirement Matrices across major regimes (e.g., FinCEN CDD, FATCA/CRS, EU 5MLD/6MLD, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, MAS, HKMA, FCA).

* Set up dynamic Document Requirement Matrices, conditional document triggers, and Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) calculation rules based on entity types, ownership thresholds, and control structures.

* Configure risk scoring criteria, automated SDD/CDD/EDD triggers, and integration points for screening triggers (Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media).

**3. Entitlements, Security & Data Visibility**
-----------------------------------------------

* Design and configure granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), functional permission sets, user profiles, and multi-tier approval hierarchies.

* Configure strict data segregation and entitlement rules to enforce cross-border data privacy constraints and regional booking center restrictions.

* Implement Maker-Checker (Four-Eyes principle) controls, operational segregation of duties (SoD), and compliance sign-off stage-gates.

**4. Data Modeling, UI Forms & Business Rules**
-----------------------------------------------

* Configure entity data models, complex multi-tier parent-subsidiary hierarchies, fund structures, authorized signers, and related parties in Fenergo.

* Build dynamic, conditional UI forms, custom data groups, dropdown hierarchies, and field-level validation rules.

* Configure data validation rules, format masking, and conditional visibility logic across various stages of the client journey.

**5. Technical Governance, Packaging & Releases**
-------------------------------------------------

* Manage configuration asset version control, configuration deltas, XML/JSON deployment packages, and migration scripts across Dev, UAT, Staging, and Production environments.

* Perform pre-release impact assessments for Fenergo core upgrades, service packs, and policy changes to ensure backward compatibility and prevent configuration regressions.

* Troubleshoot advanced configuration defects, data structure inconsistencies, and journey bottlenecks in production and pre-production environments.

**Skills & Qualifications**
===========================

**Must-Have Technical Expertise (Mandatory)**
---------------------------------------------

* **Banking & Domain Background:** 12 to 15 years of solid experience in Corporate/Investment Banking or Wholesale Financial Services, with deep exposure to KYC/AML, Client Onboarding, Due Diligence (CDD/EDD), and regulatory compliance operations.

* **Senior Fenergo Hands-On Experience:** Demonstrable, in-depth configuration experience on enterprise Fenergo CLM platforms (v8.x, v9.x, and/or SaaS/Cloud editions).

* **Fenergo Journey & Workflow Mastery:** Extensive track record building and debugging complex, multi-entity journeys, stage-gates, parallel branches, and exception routing rules.

* **Policy Engine & Rules Configuration:** Proven hands-on capability in configuring Fenergo Policy Manager, Entity Requirements Matrix, Dynamic Document Engine, and UBO threshold rules.

* **Entitlement & Access Model Setup:** Direct experience configuring complex user roles, permissions, data-level visibility rules, and cross-jurisdictional entitlement frameworks.

* **Entity Data Modeling:** Deep expertise in configuring Fenergo data dictionaries, custom attributes, entity relationship mapping, and dynamic UI forms.

* **Environment & Package Management:** Hands-on experience preparing configuration packages, managing environment-specific variables, and executing zero-downtime configuration deployments across multi-tier environments.

**Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred)**
-----------------------------------

* **Fenergo Certification:** Fenergo Certified Product/Configuration Professional.

* **API & Interface Payload Understanding:** Strong functional familiarity with REST API / JSON / XML payload structures and data mapping dictionaries for integrating Fenergo with external screening engines (e.g., Fircosoft, World-Check), Core Banking, and Document Repositories.

* **External Data Provider Integration:** Experience configuring data enrichment lookups and connectors (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Bureau van Dijk/Orbis, Companies House, Refinitiv, GLEIF).

* **Industry Compliance Certifications:** ACAMS (CAMS) or ICA Diploma in AML/KYC.

* **Agile Delivery:** Experience working in JIRA/Confluence within a Scrum/SAFe technical delivery model.

description:
Location: Chennai, India (GTBC)
  
Experience: 2+ Years
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Work Schedule: General Shift | 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST, with periodic North America synchronization calls

##### **Role Overview**

CS TECH Ai is looking for an Edge OS & Container Security Engineer to strengthen the cybersecurity posture of Linux-based industrial edge devices and containerized applications deployed in manufacturing environments.

The role will focus on container security, Linux operating system hardening, vulnerability management, network isolation, and compliance with industrial cybersecurity standards. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Linux administration, Docker security, vulnerability scanning, and network security, along with a strong understanding of secure deployment practices in production-critical industrial environments.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

###### **1. Container Security & Vulnerability Management**

* Perform container image vulnerability assessments using JFrog Xray, Trivy, Grype, or equivalent security scanning tools.
* Execute Open Source Security Analysis (OSSA) approvals for container images and track identified vulnerabilities through remediation or formally approved exceptions.
* Enforce container security best practices, including non-root execution, minimal base images, secure secrets management, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and signing.
* Assess CVEs, prioritize security findings based on severity and risk, and coordinate remediation with application and engineering teams.
* Maintain container security assessment reports and compliance evidence.

###### **2. Linux Operating System Hardening**

* Implement and maintain Linux security hardening baselines for Debian and Ubuntu distributions, aligned with applicable CIS Benchmarks.
* Configure and validate security controls such as Secure Boot, Trusted Platform Module (TPM), and disk encryption.
* Manage operating system patching, security updates, configuration baselines, and system integrity checks.
* Identify OS-level vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and unnecessary services, and implement appropriate corrective measures.
* Validate security configurations in laboratory environments before deployment to production edge devices.

###### **3. Network Security & Isolation**

* Implement and maintain network separation between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) environments.
* Configure and validate dual-NIC network architectures, disable unused network interfaces and ports, and enforce deny-by-default firewall policies.
* Manage Linux firewall rules using iptables or nftables.
* Secure MQTT-based communications using TLS and appropriate authentication and certificate-management practices.
* Review network configurations to minimize attack surfaces and prevent unauthorized communication between industrial edge devices and external networks.

###### **4. Cybersecurity Research & Standards Compliance**

* Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), security advisories, and vulnerabilities affecting Linux, containers, and industrial edge environments.
* Conduct monthly cybersecurity market and technology research to identify relevant tools, emerging threats, and opportunities for security improvement.
* Evaluate applicable industrial cybersecurity standards, including IEC 62443, and recommend practical security enhancements.
* Translate security standards and technical requirements into actionable checklists, implementation guidelines, and engineering procedures.
* Support continuous improvement of edge security architecture, vulnerability management processes, and compliance practices.

###### **5. Documentation & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Maintain audit-ready records of vulnerability scans, OSSA approvals, security test results, remediation activities, and compliance checklists.
* Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, and global cybersecurity teams to investigate and resolve security findings.
* Escalate critical vulnerabilities and security risks in accordance with established processes.
* Follow change management procedures and ensure security changes are documented, tested, and approved before production deployment.
* Participate in technical reviews and periodic security assessments to support secure and reliable industrial operations.

##### **Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience administering Debian/Ubuntu Linux environments, including Bash scripting and OS hardening.
* Proficiency in Docker, Docker Compose, Dockerfile security best practices, and container security fundamentals.
* Experience with vulnerability assessment tools such as JFrog Xray, Trivy, Grype, or equivalent solutions.
* Understanding of CVEs, vulnerability severity, remediation workflows, and open-source software security assessment.
* Solid knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, network segmentation, and Linux firewall configuration using iptables or nftables.
* Understanding of TLS, MQTT security, certificate management, and secure network communication.
* Knowledge of Linux security controls, patch management, access control, and system integrity.
* Strong documentation, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

##### **Preferred Skills & Qualifications**

* Familiarity with AppArmor or SELinux and Linux mandatory access control mechanisms.
* Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks and industrial cybersecurity standards, particularly IEC 62443.
* Exposure to Secure Boot, TPM, full-disk encryption, and security controls for industrial edge devices.
* Experience with SBOM generation, signing, software supply chain security, and container image compliance.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub, version control, and basic Python scripting.
* Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, LFCS, RHCSA, or DevSecOps/security certifications are an advantage.
* Exposure to manufacturing, Industrial IoT, Operational Technology (OT), or production-critical environments is preferred.

##### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline, preferably with a focus on cybersecurity.
* Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience in Linux administration, container security, vulnerability management, or infrastructure security.
* Demonstrated ability to implement security controls while maintaining system stability and operational availability.

##### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking and a security-first approach to engineering.
* Process-oriented execution with attention to detail, documentation, and change control.
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning in the evolving cybersecurity landscape.
* Effective communication and collaboration across technical teams and international time zones.
* A production-focused mindset, with an emphasis on testing, reliability, and minimizing manufacturing downtime.

##### **Key Skills**
